fullDescription: Professional enterprise assessment and reporting dashboard style. Features a clean dual-pane layout with a high-contrast sidebar, sophisticated typography using Plus Jakarta Sans and JetBrains Mono, and a technical blue-centric color palette (#2563eb). Designed for HR tech, fintech, SaaS analytics, and professional evaluation platforms. Incorporates radar charts for data visualization and high-density information grids.
prompt:
## Resumo
A modern, authoritative reporting dashboard designed for detailed evaluations and professional summaries. The aesthetic balances corporate reliability with high-tech precision, utilizing a light slate background, crisp white 'paper' cards, and vibrant primary blue accents.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with a professional, data-centric aesthetic. **Colors:** Background: #f8fafc; Sidebar: #ffffff; Primary Blue: #2563eb; Success Green: #16a34a; Warning Amber: #d97706; Text Primary: #1e293b; Text Muted: #94a3b8. **Typography:** Primary UI: 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (Weights: 400, 500, 600, 800). Numeric/Data Font: 'JetBrains Mono' (Weight: 400, 500). Use 10px uppercase tracking-widest text (0.1em) for labels. **Shadows:** Main card uses 0 10px 40px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08). **Borders:** Slate-200 for generic borders, Slate-100 for subtle dividers. **Animations:** Smooth transitions (transition-all, duration-200ms) for buttons and hover states; scale-110 on floating action buttons.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sidebar Navigation
Width: 288px. White background with a right border (#e2e8f0). Top section includes a brand logo and a dual-line title (18px bold title, 10px uppercase subtitle). Nav links: 14px font, medium weight, 10px vertical padding. Active state: #eff6ff background, #2563eb text, left-aligned icon. Bottom section: A dedicated status box with light blue background (#eff6ff) and 10px bold uppercase labels.

### Action Header
Height: 64px. Background: #ffffff. Border-bottom: #e2e8f0. Left side: Back button with icon, vertical divider, and 18px bold section title. Right side: Two-button group. Button 1: Outlined (Slate-200), 14px bold text. Button 2: Solid Blue (#2563eb), white text, shadow-lg (#dbeafe), 14px bold.

### Main Report Card
Container: max-width 960px. Background: #ffffff. Rounded-3xl (24px). Padding: 48px. Layout: Vertical stack of sections. Top section: Profile header with a 80x80px avatar (rounded-2xl) and a 3-column metadata grid (Label: 10px uppercase, Value: 14px bold). Score Badge: Inline-flex container, primary blue background, rounded-2xl, featuring a 36px Mono font score.

### Competency Radar Section
Two-column grid layout. Left col: Radar Chart (SVG) with a slate grid (#e2e8f0) and a semi-transparent blue fill (rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2)) with 2px blue stroke. 10px bold labels positioned around the axes. Right col: Strengths and Weaknesses lists with icons (check-circle and help-circle) and colored headers (Green-600/Amber-600).

### Detailed Feedback Blocks
Section headers: 14px bold, uppercase, tracking-widest, with a 4px left border (#2563eb). Content: Background #f8fafc, rounded-2xl, 24px padding. Text: 14px leading-relaxed. Recommendation cards: 3-column grid, horizontal cards with light border/bg-tint and bold 18px status text.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Score Badge Widget — A high-contrast badge for primary metrics.
Create a vertical badge with #2563eb background. Top label: 10px uppercase white (opacity 80). Center: JetBrains Mono 36px white text. Bottom: 10px white sub-text. Border-radius: 16px. Box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2).

### Floating Action Button — Minimalist circular FAB for utility actions.
56x56px circular button. Background: #0f172a (Slate-900). Text: #ffffff. Icon: Lucide icon 24px. Shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25). Hover: scale-110, transition: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 200ms.
